_doc: Lyric OCR gold fixture. Each page lists its lyric rows with a pixel bbox, the true script (Greek|Latin|Arabic|mixed), reading direction (ltr|rtl), and the normalized (NFC) expected text. Score with: uv run python tools/audit_lyric_ocr.py score. Bootstrap row boxes from layout segmentation with: uv run python tools/audit_lyric_ocr.py bootstrap --pages <png...>. Requires the tesseract binary + language packs (brew install tesseract tesseract-lang).
